children: 15+ years of experience spanning executive search, leadership hiring, talent strategy and critical recruitment across diverse business functions

Gitanjali Dhotre has joined Shapoorji Pallonji Real Estate as Head – Talent Acquisition, bringing more than 15 years of experience in executive search, corporate hiring, recruitment and HR leadership. Her mandate includes supporting talent strategy, leadership pipelines and critical hiring across business functions.

Dhotre moves to Shapoorji Pallonji Real Estate from Hector & Streak Consulting, where she most recently served as Group Leader – Support Functions. She previously held the position of Vertical Head – Finance, Marketing, FMCG & Retail at the consulting firm.

Her experience spans mid- to CXO-level hiring across diverse functions. Over the course of her career, she has worked with organisations and senior stakeholders on leadership and critical talent requirements, with a focus on aligning recruitment with business needs and longer-term workforce priorities.
Before joining Hector & Streak Consulting, Dhotre served as HR Manager at CCHR, where she managed the end-to-end recruitment cycle for middle and senior-level positions.

She began her professional career with APTECH as an HR Administrator, gaining experience in human resources and recruitment before moving into roles with broader responsibilities across talent acquisition and executive hiring.

In her new role, Dhotre will work with business and leadership teams on talent strategies designed to support organisational requirements and strengthen leadership pipelines. Her experience spans recruitment across levels and functions, including critical and senior leadership roles.

Her approach to talent acquisition centres on understanding business requirements, identifying capability needs and aligning hiring with organisational priorities. The role also involves strengthening talent processes and stakeholder partnerships while supporting candidate experience throughout the recruitment cycle.

Dhotre's move aligns with a broader trend among organisations to focus on leadership hiring and building talent pipelines for specialised and critical roles. Her background across executive search and corporate recruitment provides experience across both external talent markets and organisational hiring requirements.
At Shapoorji Pallonji Real Estate, her responsibilities will bring together this experience as the company continues to address its leadership and talent acquisition requirements.
With more than a decade and a half of experience across recruitment and talent acquisition, Dhotre's new role marks a further expansion of her work in leadership and critical talent hiring.
